useful_behavior: Given a plain consequential goal, deterministically map the goal's required operations, entities, constraints, and output contract onto semantically compatible capabilities already present in Brain's bound capability registry before invoking external supplier discovery; preserve ambiguity and fail closed when no binding is justified.
scope_boundaries: Existing bound capabilities only; supplier acquisition is downstream and separate.
No task-specific literals or serialization-specific special cases.
No model API, local model, or model artifact in the credited cognition path.
Must preserve ambiguity rather than force a binding.
Must expose auditable grounding evidence explaining why each bound capability matched or did not match.

discovery_evidence.observed_miss: Relevant CBOR/MessagePack/BSON capabilities were already bound, but plain-goal discovery instead attempted irrelevant external APT/PyPI/source-tree candidates.
